headlines.title: 반도체 덕에 … 3월 경상수지 흑자 373억달러 역대 최대

headlines.summary: 올들어 250兆 수익, 장기간 고수익 유지는 과제 보험료 적자 국면엔 수익률 하락 출산율·임금 상승폭 등도 변수 기금 불어난 지금이 '개혁 적기' 운용 독립성·전문성 뒷받침돼야 국민 노후를 책임지는 국민연금의 고수익 달성은 틀림없는 경사다. 지난해 기금 운용으로 231조원 넘는 수익을 낸 데 이어 올해도 1~4월에만 250조원 이상을 벌어들였다.

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

오늘 경제 흐름의 핵심은 **AI 기술 충격, 환율·통화정책 압박, 부동산 세제 개편**이라는 세 가지 큰 축으로 압축된다. IMF는 앤트로픽 등 고도화된 AI 모델이 금융시스템 전반에 체계적 위험을 초래할 수 있다고 경고하며, AI가 단순한 기술 혁신을 넘어 글로벌 금융 안정성의 새로운 변수로 부상하고 있음을 시사했다. 외환 시장에서는 미국 재무장관 베선트가 일본은행 총재 우에다와의 회담을 앞두고 직접적인 환율 개입보다 금리 인상을 통한 엔화 강세를 유도할 가능성이 제기되며, 달러·엔 환율 향방에 시장의 이목이 집중되고 있다. 국내에서는 부동산 세제 개편 논의가 구체화되면서 실거주 요건을 강화하는 방향으로 장기보유특별공제를 재설계하고 보유세를 단계적으로 강화하는 방안이 핵심으로 떠올랐다. 전반적으로 오늘 시장은 **기술·통화·부동산** 세 분야에서 동시다발적인 구조 변화 압력에 직면한 하루였다.

key_headlines.title: Domestic Stock-Type ETF Net Assets Surpass 200 Trillion Won for First Time
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's domestic stock-type ETFs reached 212.8 trillion won in net assets for the first time, driven by the Kospi's surge to over 7,500, reflecting strong investor confidence in domestic equities.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing exceptional momentum driven by a semiconductor boom and AI-related demand. The Kospi index has surpassed 7,500, setting new records and attracting unprecedented investor interest in domestic equities. Real estate policy is shifting toward owner-occupancy to stabilize the market and address affordability concerns. Government officials are emphasizing flexible fiscal policies to capitalize on record tax revenues expected from the semiconductor cycle. The automotive sector is experiencing significant shifts, with Kia poised to surpass Hyundai in monthly domestic sales for the first time since 1998.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korean government is taking an expansionary fiscal approach, supported by unprecedented tax revenues from the semiconductor sector boom. Director Kim Yong-beom noted that existing GDP statistics may underestimate actual economic activity due to quality improvements in semiconductors that traditional measurement systems fail to capture. First quarter real GDP growth of 1.7% significantly exceeded the Bank of Korea's projection of 0.9%, suggesting stronger underlying economic momentum. Global interest rate pressures are mounting, with the Bank of Korea's deputy governor suggesting it may be time to halt rate cuts and consider increases instead. The government is implementing tax reforms to discourage speculative real estate investment while supporting owner-occupancy.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic stock-type ETFs surged to record net assets of 212.8 trillion won, representing 47% of the entire ETF market's 456.2 trillion won in assets. Retail investors are increasingly shifting retirement funds toward equity-based products and away from guaranteed principal products, reflecting confidence in market prospects. The Kospi's strong performance has driven overall ETF growth, with total ETF net assets rising by 50 trillion won in just one month after crossing 400 trillion won. Retirement pension funds are concentrating heavily on AI and semiconductor sectors, with diversified investment through ETFs and domestic stock instruments accounting for over 70% of allocations. Investors are transitioning from conservative bank interest strategies to performance-based equity products.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korean researchers at KAIST achieved a breakthrough in understanding lithium-metal battery degradation, identifying the exact moment when battery performance begins to deteriorate. This discovery could significantly extend electric vehicle range and battery lifespan, addressing critical challenges in EV adoption. The research provides design guidelines for improving energy density in batteries beyond current graphite-based systems. Lithium-metal batteries can store substantially more energy than conventional batteries, making them crucial for next-generation energy storage applications. These advancements are expected to accelerate commercial deployment of superior battery technologies while reducing vehicle charging times.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment price appreciation has moderated with a 0.18% weekly increase, down from 0.21% the previous week, as sellers rush to complete transactions before the multi-property owner capital gains tax incentive expires on May 10. While outer districts show continued strength, high-value areas like Gangnam are experiencing price declines, reflecting market segmentation. Real estate experts overwhelmingly oppose government plans to strengthen regulations on non-resident single-homeowners, citing concerns that reduced rental supply will drive up tenant costs. Property sales market dynamics are mixed with significant bargain listings being absorbed, but new supply remains limited, suggesting potential inventory shortages in June-July. Government plans include redesigning long-term holding deductions and gradually increasing property holding taxes to prioritize owner-occupants.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve faces mounting pressure from the Trump administration to cut interest rates, with new FOMC voting members predominantly favoring rate reductions despite persistent inflation concerns. A scheduled Trump-Xi summit on May 14-15 will address trade tensions, while the U.S. appeals a court ruling declaring global tariffs unlawful, signaling continued trade policy uncertainty. European automakers have incurred approximately 8 billion euros (14 trillion won) in tariff costs over the past year following U.S. tariff increases. Global interest rate pressures are rising, impacting monetary policy decisions across major economies as central banks navigate inflation and growth concerns. Eurozone first-quarter growth provisional figures showed 0.1% quarter-over-quarter expansion, slightly below expectations.
sections.AI & Economy: AI-driven demand from data centers and electric vehicle expansion is spurring industrial metals markets, shifting investor focus from precious metals to copper and aluminum. Rapid growth in power infrastructure, distribution networks, and cooling system investments is driving commodity demand in response to AI sector expansion. Retail investors have achieved significant returns through AI-focused portfolios, with some strategies generating 318% returns amid strategic allocation to growth-oriented biotech and semiconductor acceleration themes. Financial institutions are deploying AI capabilities for proactive market briefings and service enhancements to improve client investment advisory. The widespread adoption of AI in corporate operations is strengthening job seeker preference for public sector employment, where automation risks and salary stability appear more favorable compared to private corporations.
sections.Others: Korean golfer Ham Jung-woo finished tied 23rd at the LIV Golf Virginia tournament, maintaining solid performance after earlier ranking swings during the three-round competition. The government is reviewing plans to reduce incentives for rental property investors, particularly targeting Gangnam-area properties, as part of broader real estate market reform. Investment experts recommend maintaining diversified portfolios across countries and sectors while increasing AI exposure, emphasizing disciplined long-term strategies and staged buying principles. The first U.S. investment project under a major economic package is scheduled for public disclosure in June, with negotiations focusing on maintaining existing bilateral trade frameworks to minimize uncertainty. Saturday business hours have been extended for local administrative offices handling final applications for multi-property owner tax incentives before the May 10 deadline.
